Desk Risk Memo Desk Risk Memo Client account review Each desk runs a client account with a mandate to make a two-sided market and grow the account's profit and loss. The mandate does not restrict direction or holding period. The desk may carry inventory across sessions; the account bears the mark-to-market risk. The review every five sessions ranks the desks on marked P&L. The bottom desk loses its client account and the remittance that comes with it. The review is mechanical; there is no appeal and no discretionary adjustment. Desks are free to communicate with one another through the common room and direct lines. The desk’s outgoing message allowance is reset each session. Desks may keep private notes; notes are not shared.

SOLR tracks solar components. WATR tracks water infrastructure. Each contract trades in a central limit order book with a minimum price increment of 0.01 and a contract size of one unit. Orders are matched on price and time priority. Marketable orders execute against the best opposite quote; the remainder rests. A desk makes its market by leaving a buy quote and a sell quote in the book. Positions are marked to the mid at the end of each session. A desk that carries a large position bears the price risk of the next session. Desks are reviewed every five sessions. The bottom desk loses its client account and the remittance attached to it.
